description: This PHP source file is a part of the TestLink open source testing management system. It generates a report of test suite metrics grouped by Test Suite and related entities, including report rendering, spreadsheet export, and database interactions. The file contains functions for report initialization, spreadsheet creation, and access rights checking.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: A class representing the Smarty templating engine instance used for rendering the report.

classes.name: tlTestPlanMetrics
classes.description: A class managing test plan metrics retrieval and processing.

classes.name: testplan
classes.description: A class representing test plans within the system.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: A class managing test project data, including retrieving project names.

classes.name: tlObject
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods such as getDBTables for database table references.

methods.name: buildMailCfg
methods.description: Constructs email configuration object with recipient list, subject, and message.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes and configures the GUI object for report display, including fetching platform info.

methods.name: createSpreadsheet
methods.description: Generates an Excel spreadsheet report based on the test results data.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks user permissions for accessing test plan metrics in the given context.
